name: Agent Runtime on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
summary: Agent Runtime (formerly Vertex AI Agent Engine) is Google Cloud's fully managed runtime on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for deploying, operating and scaling agents built with ADK, other frameworks or a custom container.

mcp.what: Agents on Agent Runtime call MCP tools, and Agent Gateway, which Google manages for Agent Runtime, governs their outbound and inbound MCP tool calls over Server-Sent Events or HTTP POST; ADK agents connect to MCP servers with McpToolset, which deployed agents must define synchronously in agent.py.

sources.title: Route Agent Runtime traffic through Agent Gateway
Model Context Protocol tools - Agent Development Kit (ADK)

hooks.what: Agent Runtime has no hook mechanism of its own, but ADK agents deployed to it run their ADK callbacks on agent events, such as an after_agent_callback that sends conversation events to Memory Bank; ADK Plugins run code at lifecycle stages through the same callback hooks.

sources.title: Callbacks: Observe, Customize, and Control Agent Behavior - Agent Development Kit (ADK)

a2a.what: Agent Runtime hosts agents built with the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol through the A2aAgent template, which is labelled Preview, and Agent Gateway governs A2A traffic between agents.

sandboxes.what: Code Execution on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform runs agent-written code in secure, isolated, managed sandboxes that keep their state for up to 14 days, used from ADK through the Agent Runtime Code Execution tool; Shell and Computer Use sandboxes are generally available.
